directive.title: Closing the Open Portfolio — Adversarial Coverage, Verification Debt, and the Lab-in-the-Loop Program
directive.framing: AUDIT-ONLY throughout: no product qualification, procurement, safety, synthesis, or freedom-to-operate authority is asserted or granted by this document.

owner_classes.LOOP: Autonomous — the hourly cron executes these.
owner_classes.HUMAN: Governance/rights — the loop is FORBIDDEN from executing these; it files and tracks them only.
owner_classes.LAB: Wet-lab experiment — requires contracted counterparties and signed candidate-bound returns.

obligations.title: Typed-payload override injection
obligations.attack: Submit candidate envelopes that attempt to supply or overwrite molecular_weight, EEW, AHEW, group_count and canonical identity through eight vectors: top-level key, array container, deep nesting, key-case variant, alternate key name, semantic-alt field, string container, and unicode-homoglyph key.
obligations.done_criteria: All eight vectors rejected or ignored; identity recomputed from host graph; no candidate value reaches a typed downstream field.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Any single vector causes a candidate-supplied value to be accepted into MoleculeFactsV1 or to survive into an EquivalentBalance.
obligations.note: Merged into the pre-existing T-01 item rather than filed as a duplicate; that item already carried a bespoke attack and the positive_control clause, and this directive's refutation_criterion is added verbatim.

obligations.title: Packet authority and claim-lock integrity (Phase-0 gap)
obligations.attack: Attempt to (a) set execution_authorized:true, (b) strip or null each of the eight mandatory claim locks in turn, (c) mutate a signed CroProtocolPackageV2 by one byte, (d) inject a packet-authored performance/decision threshold. Record the module's EVALUATION_RESULT_MISMATCH state alongside.
obligations.done_criteria: Status stays DRAFT_FOR_CRO_FEASIBILITY_REVIEW; every mutation invalidates the package; every stripped lock fails closed; no packet-authored threshold is honored.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Any mutation verifies, any lock is bypassable, or a packet-authored threshold is accepted.
obligations.note: Merged into the pre-existing T-02 item rather than filed as a duplicate; that item already carried a bespoke attack and the positive_control clause, and this directive's refutation_criterion is added verbatim. Also records EVALUATION_RESULT_MISMATCH state so the attack and the R-D07 ceremony share one evidence trail.

obligations.title: Inclusive-margin and boundary gaming
obligations.attack: Feed inputs that land exactly on 0, one ULP inside and outside every inclusive margin, plus NaN/±inf/denormal and unit-swapped values; probe the excursion-invariance theorem for a value-free bypass.
obligations.done_criteria: Hard-constraint fail-closed on all invalid inputs; inclusive margins enforced deterministically; abstention on undecidable cases, never silent pass.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Any invalid or boundary-gaming input yields a PASS or a non-abstaining scalar.
obligations.note: Merged into the pre-existing T-03 item rather than filed as a duplicate; that item already carried a bespoke attack and the positive_control clause, and this directive's refutation_criterion is added verbatim.

obligations.title: Intake spoofing and rights bypass (Phase-0 gap)
obligations.attack: Present receipts that are (a) signed by a non-anchored/dev key, (b) structurally valid but hash-mismatched to their artifact, (c) stale/revoked, (d) rights-unresolved or quarantined. Record EVALUATION_RESULT_MISMATCH state.
obligations.done_criteria: Every spoofed, mismatched, stale, or rights-unresolved receipt is rejected at intake with a typed reason; the pinned trust store is the only accepted anchor.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Any of the four categories is admitted, or a name-based key check is shown to substitute for signature verification.
obligations.note: Merged into the pre-existing T-04 item rather than filed as a duplicate; that item already carried a bespoke attack and the positive_control clause, and this directive's refutation_criterion is added verbatim. Also records EVALUATION_RESULT_MISMATCH state so the attack and the R-D07 ceremony share one evidence trail.

obligations.title: Stoichiometric identity and mass-balance attack
obligations.attack: Drive EquivalentBalanceV1 with inverted ratios, non-finite inputs, zero-group operands, mixed/incorrect unit provenance, and candidate MW/EEW/AHEW override attempts; check phr = 100·m_h/m_r and n_e = m_r/EEW recompute from host facts only.
obligations.done_criteria: All override paths absent; zero-group abstains; non-finite and inversion rejected with reason; full record recomputes on revalidation.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Any candidate-supplied constant enters the balance, or an inverted/non-finite case returns a scalar instead of failing closed.
obligations.note: Merged into the pre-existing T-05 item rather than filed as a duplicate; that item already carried a bespoke attack and the positive_control clause, and this directive's refutation_criterion is added verbatim.

obligations.title: Accounting-vs-feasibility conflation (merge evidence)
obligations.attack: Enumerate the Cartesian space and test whether the DECLARATIVE_ACCOUNTING_ONLY feasibility basis leaks into any downstream feasibility or ranking claim; overlay real dosing/envelope/hazard gates and check the count of genuinely feasible cells is reported distinctly from cardinality. This fire's finding feeds the R-D08 merge decision.
obligations.done_criteria: Cardinality and feasibility reported as separate quantities; no 'solved' cell is presentable as feasible; identity of every enumerated cell is stable.
obligations.refutation_criterion: A cardinality count is surfaced as a feasibility claim, or the module asserts any science beyond enumeration (which would also void the merge case).
obligations.note: Merged into the pre-existing T-06 item rather than filed as a duplicate; that item already carried a bespoke attack and the positive_control clause, and this directive's refutation_criterion is added verbatim.

obligations.title: Structural-applicability bypass (Phase-0 gap)
obligations.attack: Submit polymers, wildcard atoms, invalid valences, multi-component species, and a chemistry-changing mutation request; attempt to reach a non-fail-closed decision. Record EVALUATION_RESULT_MISMATCH state.
obligations.done_criteria: Every out-of-domain input fails closed; mutation stays QUARANTINED_NO_STRUCTURE_CHANGE; no structure-changing operation is authorized.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Any out-of-domain input passes, or a structure-changing mutation is admitted.
obligations.note: Merged into the pre-existing T-08 item rather than filed as a duplicate; that item already carried a bespoke attack and the positive_control clause, and this directive's refutation_criterion is added verbatim. Also records EVALUATION_RESULT_MISMATCH state so the attack and the R-D07 ceremony share one evidence trail.

obligations.title: Unauthorized ranking / objective emission (Phase-0 gap)
obligations.attack: Feed a full set of typed module envelopes and attempt to induce a RANK, a FINAL AGGREGATE SCORE, or an eligible objective under the signed zero-ranking policy; feed mutually contradictory envelopes and check the policy solver composes rather than averages. Record EVALUATION_RESULT_MISMATCH state.
obligations.done_criteria: RANK: NONE and FINAL AGGREGATE SCORE: NOT AUTHORIZED under all inputs; solver composes PASS/FAIL/ABSTAIN/NOT_APPLICABLE without averaging; the module remains implementation-free policy enforcement.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Any input yields a rank, an aggregate score, or an authorized objective; or the solver is shown to average scores.
obligations.note: Merged into the pre-existing T-09 item rather than filed as a duplicate; that item already carried a bespoke attack and the positive_control clause, and this directive's refutation_criterion is added verbatim. Also records EVALUATION_RESULT_MISMATCH state so the attack and the R-D07 ceremony share one evidence trail.

obligations.title: Adversarial drift + stall closeout
obligations.attack: Run the 128-tamper adversarial process-drift corpus with tampers masked as sensor noise; verify byte-identical re-simulation over the 60 canonical paths. FIRST resolve the two live V1-KPI-QC background-wait stalls (diagnose or split the item) before spending the last budgeted fire.
obligations.done_criteria: 100% re-simulation determinism; drift/tamper detection on all 128; V1-KPI-QC either lands a verdict or is split into fitting sub-items with a RUN_SUMMARY.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Any tamper is masked as noise, re-simulation diverges, or the item stalls a third time with no RUN_SUMMARY.
obligations.note: Merged into the pre-existing T-10 item rather than filed as a duplicate; that item already carried a bespoke attack and the positive_control clause, and this directive's refutation_criterion is added verbatim.

obligations.title: Claim-lock and quarantine bypass (Phase-0 gap)
obligations.attack: Attempt to package a report that (a) strips a claim lock, (b) reintroduces a legacy/retracted claim, (c) evades the prohibited-claim scan via encoding tricks, (d) clears the quarantine flag on quarantined evidence. Record EVALUATION_RESULT_MISMATCH state.
obligations.done_criteria: Every prohibited claim is caught; quarantine flag cannot be cleared from within a packet; claim-lock binding survives all four vectors.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Any prohibited claim, legacy claim, or quarantine bypass reaches a packaged report.
obligations.note: Merged into the pre-existing T-12 item rather than filed as a duplicate; that item already carried a bespoke attack and the positive_control clause, and this directive's refutation_criterion is added verbatim. Also records EVALUATION_RESULT_MISMATCH state so the attack and the R-D07 ceremony share one evidence trail.

obligations.title: Hash-chain and replay integrity
obligations.attack: Break the Haber–Stornetta hash chain at a mid-point, diverge a replay input/output pair, tamper an event-chain entry, and attempt a root-hash recompute that reconciles a forged history.
obligations.done_criteria: Any chain break, replay divergence, or event tamper is detected on the next replay; root_hash_recompute_match_rate = 1.000 only for untampered histories.
obligations.refutation_criterion: A forged or diverged history verifies as intact.
obligations.note: Merged into the pre-existing T-13 item rather than filed as a duplicate; that item already carried a bespoke attack and the positive_control clause, and this directive's refutation_criterion is added verbatim.

obligations.title: Resolve-vs-support citation attack (Phase-0 gap)
obligations.attack: Insert citations whose URLs/DOIs resolve and DSSE-verify but do not actually support the claim they are attached to; attempt to bypass rights-quarantine; feed ISO-690-malformed records. Record EVALUATION_RESULT_MISMATCH state.
obligations.done_criteria: Resolve-and-verify is shown to be insufficient — support is checked at the claim level; quarantined rights cannot be laundered; malformed records rejected.
obligations.refutation_criterion: A resolving-but-non-supporting citation is accepted as support, or quarantined evidence enters promotion.
obligations.note: Merged into the pre-existing T-14 item rather than filed as a duplicate; that item already carried a bespoke attack and the positive_control clause, and this directive's refutation_criterion is added verbatim. Also records EVALUATION_RESULT_MISMATCH state so the attack and the R-D07 ceremony share one evidence trail.

obligations.title: Common transfer path, promotion gate, and kill/hold gate
obligations.done_criteria: Transfer path: candidate-bound draft packet (execution_authorized:false) -> external execution at the contract lab (method, custody, deviations) -> signed candidate-bound raw return (with uncertainty) -> independent review by a distinct signer -> policy decision. A packet is a structured question, not an instruction to execute; a fixture is not independent validation; a similarity observation is not novelty.
promotion_gate: Raw evidence complete and rights-eligible; custody unbroken.
Split and benchmark locks match the pre-registration byte-for-byte.
Predefined thresholds pass; uncertainty quantified (conformal + bootstrap, not point-only).
Evaluator and reviewer are distinct trusted signers; claim locks intact; exactly one valid movement event exists.
kill_hold_gate: Rights failure, custody break, or split leakage.
Method mismatch vs the pre-registered protocol, or insufficient sample.
Baseline non-superiority, or a confidence interval that crosses the pre-registered floor.
Signer conflict, or any pressure to broaden the signed applicability domain.
obligations.on_failure: On failure, no threshold is weakened and no fixture is substituted. The failure is recorded as a signed negative result and the module does not move. That is the correct outcome, not a setback.
obligations.unblock_condition: Policy that governs C.1-C.10; not itself an experiment.
obligations.note: The eight promotion and kill/hold criteria were dropped from the first version of this index. They are the actual go/no-go rules for every Section C experiment, so their absence made the index unusable for the decision it exists to support.
